jass_v335.Leg_Spawn:
function Leg_Spawn takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit lg = null
    local integer tries = 0
    local integer i = 0
    local integer c = 0
    local real x = 0.0
    local real y = 0.0
    if Leg_N == 0 then
        return
    endif
    // v3.3.4: a random legend among those that have not appeared yet
    loop
        exitwhen i >= Leg_N
        if Leg_Up[i] == 0 then
            set c = c + 1
        endif
        set i = i + 1
    endloop
    if c == 0 then
        return
    endif
    set tries = GetRandomInt(1, c)
    set i = -1
    loop
        set i = i + 1
        if Leg_Up[i] == 0 then
            set tries = tries - 1
        endif
        exitwhen tries == 0
    endloop
    set c = 0
    if Wild_CampN > 0 then
        set c = GetRandomInt(0, Wild_CampN - 1)
        set x = Wild_CampX[c]
        set y = Wild_CampY[c]
    endif
    set lg = CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_AGGRESSIVE), Leg_Type[i], x, y, 270.0)
    call SaveInteger(Ab_HT, GetHandleId(lg), 0, LoadInteger(Ab_HT, Leg_Type[i], 0))  // v3.3: legends have an Ability
    set lg = null
    set Leg_Alive = Leg_Alive + 1
    set Leg_Up[i] = 1
    call PingMinimap(x, y, 5.0)
    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, 10.0, "|cffff66ccA wild " + Leg_Name[i] + " (Lv 100) appeared! Only level 100 Pokemon can hurt it.|r")
endfunction
jass_v335.Leg_OnDeath:
function Leg_OnDeath takes unit u returns nothing
    local integer i = 0
    loop
        exitwhen i >= Leg_N
        if Leg_Type[i] == GetUnitTypeId(u) then
            set Leg_Alive = Leg_Alive - 1
            // v3.3.4: Leg_Up stays 1, the legend never comes back
            if GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= Leg_SoulChance then
                call CreateItem(Leg_Soul[i], GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u))
                call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, 10.0, "|cffff66cc" + Leg_Name[i] + " dropped its Soul!|r")
            else
                call CreateItem('I00B', GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u))
                call CreateItem('I001', GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u))
                call CreateItem('I000', GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u))
            endif
            return
        endif
        set i = i + 1
    endloop
endfunction
jass_v335.Mob_FullMana:
function Mob_FullMana takes unit u returns nothing
    if GetOwningPlayer(u) == Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_AGGRESSIVE) and GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA) > 0.0 then
        call SetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))
    endif
endfunction
jass_v335.Mob_OnEnter:
function Mob_OnEnter takes nothing returns boolean
    call Mob_FullMana(GetTriggerUnit())
    return false
endfunction
jass_v335.Mob_InitMana:
function Mob_InitMana takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit u = null
    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerRegisterEnterRectSimple(t, GetWorldBounds())
    call TriggerAddCondition(t, Condition(function Mob_OnEnter))
    call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(Wild_Tmp, Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_AGGRESSIVE), null)
    loop
        set u = FirstOfGroup(Wild_Tmp)
        exitwhen u == null
        call GroupRemoveUnit(Wild_Tmp, u)
        call Mob_FullMana(u)
    endloop
    set t = null
endfunction
